cohort: A total of 50 pregnant women at 37 weeks gestation or more, comprising 25 with isolated oligohydramnios and 25 age, parity, and gestational age-matched controls with normal liquor, all without high-risk factors.
finding: Isolated oligohydramnios is associated with increased rates of induction of labor, augmentation of labor, meconium-stained liquor, and non-reassuring fetal heart patterns, as well as higher caesarean section rates, without a significant increase in neonatal morbidity or mortality.
mod_finding: Isolated oligohydramnios was associated with increased caesarean section rates.
